g.text: UML collaborators — rooms, reactions, forest, sessions and weather
Four bounded E2 responsibilities; room presence, short-lived reactions, focus visits and dated plans have separate lifecycles.
Read / renew: membership check; no group lock.
Join / control: account locks → group lock.
Exactly one parent: group XOR connection.
Fixed campus coordinates and weather fields.
No student identity, location or schedule.
RoomAccess / SessionAccess check current account and parent authority; RoomAssembler / SessionAssembler / WeatherAssembler / ForestAssembler return DTOs.
PomodoroTimer is an immutable server-time value; FocusCredit measures focus time from it and TreeGrowth maps minutes to a TreeSpecies. SessionAvailability reuses WeeklyAvailability.
SessionEvents writes recipient notifications transactionally. Detailed E2 transaction and ER diagrams are in TEAM_C.md; E1 match explanations are in E1.md.
